# hermes-agent-squads

> Profile distribution that installs AI agent squads for Hermes Agent (NousResearch): web,
> marketing, jobs, studio, plus a builder bot that creates and maintains local squads. One
> command installs the builder; squads are manifests, skills and tested scripts.

Rules for agents: read AGENTS.md first. Verified Hermes behavior lives in
skills/hermes-platform/references/ (every fact cites a docs path under website/docs or a
source file). Never invent CLI flags: run `--help`. Model ids appear only in
scripts/data/model-roles.yaml and local/installed.yaml.

## Start

- [README.md](README.md): install in 3 commands, Desktop setup, squad overview
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): contributor contract
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): what shipped
- [builder.yaml](builder.yaml): the builder bot spec
- [distribution.yaml](distribution.yaml): what install and update touch
